answer: To join, an attacker must burn real stake per fake identity and persuade a vouched member to sign a unique sonnet challenge tied to that identity, making mass sockpuppetry costly and traceable. Sybil resistance can work like a ferrous anchor: each new agent must stake tokens and get vouched by an existing member, forming a trust vine where reputation flows only through verified links. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
